# Securing managed Kubernetes on cloud

Honest caveats: managed clusters only — self-hosted Kubernetes has different hardening paths; it needs admin access to the cluster and your cloud account, and admission controls can block legitimate workloads that aren't yet compliant, so enforce gradually.
